mode.title: What to fetch
mode.description: Search terms: interest over time, by region and related searches for your keywords. Trending now: today's trending searches in one or more countries.

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Keywords to look up, one per line. Each term is fetched separately unless you turn on comparison.

compareTerms.title: Compare terms against each other
compareTerms.description: Off: every term gets its own 0-100 scale. On: terms are compared on one shared scale, like typing them together in Google Trends. Google compares at most 5 terms at once, so longer lists are split into groups of 5 (values are only comparable inside a group).

geo.title: Location
geo.description: Country code (US, GB, DE, PK...), or country plus region (US-CA, GB-ENG). Leave empty for worldwide.

timeRange.title: Time range
timeRange.description: Ignored when start and end dates are set.

startDate.title: Custom start date
startDate.description: Optional. Use together with an end date for a custom range (from 2004-01-01).

endDate.title: Custom end date
endDate.description: Optional. Use together with a start date.

outputs.title: Data to include
outputs.description: Pick the sections you need. Fewer sections means faster runs.

searchType.title: Search type
searchType.description: Which Google search to measure: regular web search, images, news, Google Shopping or YouTube.

category.title: Category
category.description: Google Trends category id, e.g. 7 = Finance, 5 = Computers & Electronics, 71 = Food & Drink. 0 = all categories.

regionResolution.title: Region detail
regionResolution.description: Level of detail for interest by region. If Google doesn't offer that level for your location, its default level is used and reported in regionResolutionUsed.

includeLowSearchVolume.title: Include low-volume regions
includeLowSearchVolume.description: Also list regions where Google has too little data to show a value.

trendingGeos.title: Trending now: countries
trendingGeos.description: Used in Trending now mode. Country codes, e.g. US, GB, IN.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language for topic names and labels, e.g. en-US, de, fr.

timezoneOffsetMinutes.title: Timezone offset (minutes)
timezoneOffsetMinutes.description: Offset from UTC used for hourly and daily data, as Google expects it (UTC minus local time; e.g. 300 for US Eastern winter time). 0 = UTC.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Google rate-limits heavily, so a proxy is strongly recommended. The default starts with cheaper datacenter IPs and switches to residential IPs only if Google blocks.

escalateToResidential.title: Switch to residential IPs when blocked
escalateToResidential.description: After repeated blocks, retry through Apify residential proxies.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel requests
maxConcurrency.description: Terms fetched at the same time. Higher is faster but gets blocked more often.

maxRetries.title: Retries per request
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry a blocked request with a fresh IP before giving up on that term.
